summary: New aggregate table activity_returns (per mode, vessel, Toybox and Toybox vessel: players who did it on 2+, 3+ days and a week apart; no player id), built in rebuild_aggregates with a test. It is what the daily story pipeline measures 'what players come back to' from (Docs/StoryFlywheel/README.md). Reads go through /v1/query with an admin key.
